limitations: Single pretraining trajectory, six MLPs, small original diagnostic corpus; no semantic category labels.
Three noise magnitudes reuse the same 18 layer/seed directions; 54 noise rows are not 54 independent directions.
High pooled correlations partly reflect intervention strength. Fixed-strength correlations are lower.
Exact query retrieval includes the same function in the database; this is not cross-model function discovery.
FP32 scale metadata separates some identical lattice code keys; code-only collisions remain.
Primary full-model FP32 logprob tolerance failed; explicit FP64 follow-up on first failing seed confirms invariance.

decision.behavioral_index: Advance for exploratory local MLP comparisons with full-precision sketches; not a validated semantic taxonomy.
decision.primary_fidelity: Preserve failed FP32 gate; FP64 diagnosis passes at the predeclared 1e-10 follow-up threshold.
decision.e8p2_relative_gate: At 1024 coordinates, passes the preregistered relative-to-scalar criterion by about 11%, but absolute fine-distance error remains about 350%. The gate lacked an absolute-error bound; do not promote it for fine changes.
decision.e8p4_relative_gate: Fails the scalar-4 comparison at 1024 coordinates.
decision.next: Use task-specific perturbations at matched weight norms and heldout probe families; then replicate on a second Pythia seed/size. No toy fallback required by this run.
